conceptZh: 廚師動物的麵團模仿他每個動作，慢一拍，最後捏出「田」和「力」。
object: rotund chef animal and a mimicking dough lump
morph: 田 field-box and 力 strokes made of dough
creativeAngle: 麵團慢一拍模仿，造成揉麵混亂。
promptEn: Create an exactly 8-second animated comedy, locked frontal camera. Setting: a cheerful tomato-red kitchen backdrop with a cream counter; the glyph is a solid brown 男: 田 above 力. A round cartoon chef bear in a tall hat stands at left; a dough lump with two button eyes copies him. The Traditional Chinese glyph 男 stays centered and uncropped at about 70% of frame height with generous margins. Moment one (0.0-1.8s): the chef rolls his sleeves and slaps a flat slab of dough; the dough lump slaps back a beat late; the first 男 is spoken as the slap sounds. Moment two (1.8-3.5s): he cuts a square and the dough cuts a different square; they swap, mixing up; the pieces flip and land as 田 over 力; the second 男 is spoken as the last piece lands. Moment three (3.5-5.0s): he flexes a muscle in his chef coat and the dough lump copies it and bursts into two shapes; 男生 is spoken as a little toy figure in a cap pops up beside the glyph. From 5.0-8.0s the glyph 男 is perfectly still and unobstructed; the chef bows, the dough bows a beat later. Audio: one warm, friendly off-screen voice speaks slowly and distinctly in Taiwan-standard Mandarin, reading exactly these syllables with clear tones and no erhua: 「男、男、男生」 (ㄋㄢˊ、ㄋㄢˊ、ㄋㄢˊ ㄕㄥ). Timing: first utterance at about 0.5s, second at about 2.5s, the word at about 4.4s; then stop, no repeats and no extra speech. Beneath the voice only slaps and squishes, no music. The single glyph is the only on-screen text; the vocabulary stays audio-only with no subtitles, watermark, clutter or flashing.
